from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyLiability(BaseModel):
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company from the financial report")
    total_liability_amount: float | None = Field(description="The total liability amount reported in the balance sheet")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period of the financial statement")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="The currency unit of the financial figures")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_liabilities: list[CompanyLiability]
